description.en: Specifies whether to mute all users in the group.

description.zh: 被禁言的用户列表。多个用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多不超过30个。
description.en: The list of users to mute. You can specify up to 30 users. Separate multiple user IDs with a comma (,).

description.zh: 数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
description.en: The data center. This must be the same data center specified in the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~) call. Valid values: \`cn-shanghai\` (Shanghai) and \`ap-southeast-1\` (Singapore).

description.zh: 当开启全员禁言时不被禁言的用户列表。多个用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多不超过30个。
description.en: The list of users who are not muted when all users in the group are muted. You can specify up to 30 users. Separate multiple user IDs with a comma (,).

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~)创建互动消息群组。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, you must call the [CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~) operation to create an interactive messaging group.

## QPS limit

A single user can make up to 10 queries per second (QPS). If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled, which may impact your business. Call this operation at a reasonable rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live modify-live-message-group-band --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --banned-all false --bannned-users uid1 --except-users uid3 --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live ModifyLiveMessageGroupBand --region cn-hangzhou --ExceptUsers uid3 --BannnedUsers uid1 --DataCenter 'cn-shanghai' --AppId demo --BannedAll false --GroupId grouptest
